This complete edition includes the base game 'Necrophosis' and the brand new DLC 'Subconsciousness'.

description:
REPLACED is out now on Xbox: https://www.xbox.com/games/store/replaced/9nv3l234vgxd

Can an AI become human? Step into an alternate 1980s America scarred by nuclear catastrophe in this cinematic 2.5D cyberpunk platformer. You are R.E.A.C.H. - an AI trapped in a human body against its will - navigating a dark dystopia where the Phoenix Corporation’s sinister secrets lurk behind every shadow

Explore a handcrafted pixel-art world as you run, climb, and fight through crumbling districts, industrial wastelands, and stunning cityscapes. Combining seamless exploration with fast, fluid free-flow combat, you must uncover hidden agendas while grappling with the heavy weight of a borrowed life.

Experience a narrative-driven cyberpunk thriller like no other. Your journey through Phoenix City begins today.

💾 Play it now with Xbox Game Pass.
🚀 Available on Xbox Series X|S and Windows.

description:
Outerloop Games delivers Dosa Divas - a spicy narrative turn-based RPG. After years apart, sisters Samara and Amani journey with their ancient spirit-mech on a mission to defeat a rotten fast food empire and reconnect communities with their traditions. Platform through vibrant villages, battle corporate goons, reconcile with loved ones, and eat one last meal together before saying goodbye.
